what: Claude Code: the project's own block list of the guard (#7116): KALMIDO_BLOCK_EXTRA in the runner's env file (never a file in the project folder) names hosts (host:NAME -- ssh / scp / rsync / sftp / mosh targets, user@host, host:path, host.domain), commands (cmd:WORDS -- the program and these words in order) and paths (path:PATH); the guard refuses them with the same parsing as its fixed list, the runner hands the list to the hook on its command line (--block-extra, hex: the model's process cannot change it), the paths also become Read / Edit deny rules of every run and job; it holds also with KALMIDO_BLOCK_DANGEROUS=0 (only the fixed list is off then). A name check, not a wall
